subject: Mutual Action Plan: Aligning objectives, decision criteria, and timeline (Aurea Health)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@aureahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: Aligning objectives, decision criteria, and timeline (Aurea Health)

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. As discussed, I’m sending a short Mutual Action Plan (attached) to make the next 6–8 weeks explicit: goals, key stakeholders, decision criteria, and the milestones we’ll use to evaluate success.

Quick summary of what I need from you to finalize the plan:
- Confirm the internal champion and primary procurement contact (I have you listed as the champion).
- Confirm top 2–3 evaluation goals (latency SLA, inference cost per 1k tokens, model fidelity on triage examples).
- Share any compliance or SOC2 evidence owners we should loop in (I’ve attached a sample evidence request you can forward).

Proposed kickoff timeline (we can adjust):
- Week 1 (4/19–4/23): Access & sandbox provisioning; share 3 sample prompts/data slices.
- Week 2 (4/26–4/30): Pilot run and initial metrics; first quality check.
- Week 3 (5/3–5/7): Evaluate results, decision review with stakeholders.
- Week 4 (target close window 5/10–5/14): Procurement & contract finalization if metrics meet criteria.

Attachment: Aurea_MAP_v0.1.xlsx — a one-page plan with owners and due dates. I’ve copied Monica (CSM) and Karthik (solutions) so they can kick off sandbox access and scope the pilot.

Next steps: If you’re good with the timeline, reply with the procurement contact and any required compliance documents; we’ll send calendar invites and provision sandbox access on Monday.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0148

Attachment: Aurea_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
Attachment: compliance-evidence-request.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@aureahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@aureahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Aligning objectives, decision criteria, and timeline (Aurea Health)

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and appreciated for the clarity.

Confirming: I will be the champion for this evaluation (owning day-to-day feedback and acceptance). Procurement is Lisa Gomez (cc’d).

Top evaluation goals from our side:
1) Accuracy on clinical triage prompts (we’ll share 200 labeled examples)
2) Average end-to-end latency under 220ms for 512-token interactions
3) Clear audit trails for inference requests (retention and logging)

Compliance: I’m attaching an internal SOC/compliance checklist that Lisa can fill out — please send any specific evidence items we should expect.

Can we schedule a 30-minute sandbox demo on Monday 4/19 at 11:00am PT? If that works, Lisa and I will join.

Thanks,
Daniel
Director of Clinical AI | Aurea Health
daniel.park@aureahealth.com

I’ve updated the attached MAP with the acceptance criteria you listed (accuracy on triage examples, latency <220ms, audit/logging requirements) and marked owners:
- Data/sample delivery: Daniel (Aurea) — due 4/22
- Sandbox provisioning: Karthik (Redwood) — provisioning by 4/19 morning
- Pilot metrics report: Monica (Redwood CSM) — draft by 4/30

We’ll plan the sandbox demo Monday 4/19 at 11:00am PT. Karthik — can you confirm you can join and provision the sandbox before the demo? Monica — I’ll ask you to prepare the pilot metrics template so we can capture the three evaluation goals.

If procurement needs a statement of work or a draft SOW to expedite review, we can provide a standard SOW template this week.

Thanks all — I’ll send calendar invites in a moment.

Best,
Marissa

Hi all — I can join the 11:00am PT demo and will provision the sandbox this morning. Quick notes on the plan:
- Sandbox access: I’ll create a scoped environment with a token-limited test key and sample telemetry. Expect an email with access details and an onboarding note by 10:45am PT.

If procurement needs a short data processing addendum for the pilot, flag it and I’ll get legal to share a one-page addendum.
